'''Shane Engelking''' is a Star Wars CCG player. He posted on the [[Players Committee]] forum as elvis solo. In April 2004 his [[Watch Your Step / This Place Can Be A Little Rough|Watch Your Step]] deck "A bunch of simple tricks and nonsense", posted on DeckTech, was the top-rated deck there.<ref name="pcf-2827-44216">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=44216#44216 Why Watch Your Step?], challenger, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (6 April 2004). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20050106191849/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=44216%26amp Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="pcf-2827-44319">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=44319#44319 Why Watch Your Step?], challenger, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (8 April 2004). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20050106191849/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=44216%26amp Internet Archive]</ref> He won the [[Classic]] qualifier at Dragon*Con 2003 playing Profit and TDIGWATT, beating [[Damian Loback]]'s MBO along the way.<ref name="pcf-377-34439">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=34439#34439 What strategies are mostly viable in classic?], elvis solo, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (16 October 2003). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20041217215857/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=34439%26amp Internet Archive]</ref>
